requirements.requirement: The system must include the sponsor_credibility_score field in the clinical trial evaluation response payload.
The system must ensure the sponsor_credibility_score value is sourced from the output of the sponsor credibility scoring logic defined in EVAL-CT-M4-S3.
The system must expose sponsor_credibility_score through the Evaluate Care facade API endpoint for clinical trials.
The system must return sponsor_credibility_score as a normalized numeric value between 0 and 1.
The system must include sponsor_credibility_score in the same response structure as other clinical trial evaluation measures.
The system must ensure that the API response schema remains backward compatible with existing consumers when adding sponsor_credibility_score.
The system must include a null or default value for sponsor_credibility_score when the upstream scoring logic does not produce a value.
The system must not fail the entire evaluation response if sponsor_credibility_score computation is unavailable.
The system must log an error or warning when sponsor_credibility_score is missing due to upstream dependency failure.
The system must ensure that sponsor_credibility_score is included in the evaluation pipeline only after successful execution of dependency EVAL-CT-M4-S3.
The system must serialize sponsor_credibility_score in a format consistent with existing numeric evaluation fields in the API.
The system must handle missing sponsor metadata by returning sponsor_credibility_score as null or a defined fallback value without raising an exception.
The system must ensure that downstream consumers can access sponsor_credibility_score without requiring additional API calls.
The system must include sponsor_credibility_score in all clinical trial evaluation responses where evaluation is requested.
